forgotPin.title: Forgot your PIN?
forgotPin.body:
For your security, a PIN cannot be reset inside the app yet.

Please contact your clinic to have your account restored. They can verify your identity and help you get back in.

If you entered the wrong PIN five times, your account is locked for 15 minutes. Nothing is lost — just wait and try again.

errors.phoneFormat: Enter a phone number as +251 followed by 9 digits
errors.pinFormat: Your PIN must be exactly 4 digits
errors.pinMismatch: The two PINs do not match
errors.offline: You need a connection to sign in the first time
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.lockedNoTime: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
errors.phoneTaken: That phone number is already registered
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
